name: Miyake (Nara, Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Miyake town emblem in white: a ring with two pointed ears enclosing a disc.
history: Municipal flag of Miyake, a town in Nara Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Miyake town emblem — a ring with two pointed ears enclosing a disc
